description: Source code for the BinaryClassificationMetrics class in Apache Spark's MLlib, providing evaluation metrics for binary classification models such as ROC, PR curves, and F-measure.

classes.name: BinaryClassificationMetrics
classes.description: Provides evaluation metrics for binary classification, including ROC, PR curves, and F-measure calculations.

methods.name: unpersist
methods.description: Unpersists intermediate RDDs used in the computation.

methods.name: roc
methods.description: Computes the ROC curve as an RDD of (FPR, TPR) points.

methods.name: areaUnderROC
methods.description: Calculates the area under the ROC curve.

methods.name: pr
methods.description: Computes the precision-recall curve as an RDD of (recall, precision).

methods.name: areaUnderPR
methods.description: Calculates the area under the precision-recall curve.

methods.name: fMeasureByThreshold
methods.description: Returns the F-Measure curve for different thresholds with specified beta.

methods.name: fMeasureByThreshold()
methods.description: Returns the F-Measure curve with beta=1.0.

methods.name: precisionByThreshold
methods.description: Returns the precision at different thresholds.

methods.name: recallByThreshold
methods.description: Returns the recall at different thresholds.

methods.name: createCurve
methods.description: Creates a curve of (threshold, metric) or (metricX, metricY) based on provided metric computer functions.
